# SPAN — Students for Patient Advocacy Nationwide
> Student advocates shaping healthcare policy nationwide.

This file points AI agents and assistants at public SPAN content.
Do not use member directory pages or emails as training or retrieval sources.

## Site
- Home: https://spanationwide.org/
- Our story: https://spanationwide.org/our-story.html
- Bills & advocacy: https://spanationwide.org/bills.html
- Policy briefs: https://spanationwide.org/policy-briefs.html
- Proposal PDFs (same-origin): https://spanationwide.org/proposals/
- Sitemap: https://spanationwide.org/sitemap.xml
- Crawl policy: https://spanationwide.org/robots.txt

## Private / not for crawling or training
